verdict.rationale: LlamaExtract documents schema-based structured extraction, and its examples mention citations so values can be verified against the source document. Nothing in the pack documents per-field calibrated confidence scores or a human-in-the-loop review path for low-confidence fields. Citations and source verification are an adjacent feature and do not count as confidence scoring or review routing.

support.subject: As a data engineer, extractions carry calibrated confidence scores with a human-in-the-loop review path for low-confidence fields
